properties.description: After a synchronous reset edge, both response valids are clear. Reset cancels tracked obligations; invalid payloads and input readiness are unconstrained.
A blocked data response retains valid, data and last until acceptance or a reset edge.
A blocked status response retains valid and every status field until acceptance or a reset edge, independently of data readiness.

Every data presentation, including a blocked presentation, is justified by accepted input bytes or completed-frame padding. After 128 consecutive no-offer, both-ready cycles, tracked input and data obligations must be drained.

Justified data presentations preserve byte order, append zero padding to length four, truncate at length eight, and place last exactly at the expected output-frame boundary. Partial accepted prefixes are supported.

Every status presentation describes the next completed accepted input frame with exact original length, clamped length and adjustment flags. Status retires independently of data, and tracked status obligations must drain after the 128-cycle ready-high idle tail.
